Independent, rapid progress by smart people.
When people work with us

We help smart, ambitious leaders (like you?) grow companies by deploying new business models and new technologies. In particular, we give people a way to get things done quickly when the realities of operating inside a big business get in the way. We move fast, without breaking things.

Growth, without the gridlock.

We’re at our best when growth sits behind a shift towards new ways of doing business. Some of the largest leaps in growth can only be pursued through approaches that wouldn’t make sense inside the mother ship. We obsess about data and its input into iteration - which is how we remove the maximum amount of risk while pursuing new ideas that require an emergent strategy.

When we invest

We invest in like-minded founders who stand to benefit from the unreasonable advantages we build through our revenue work. We invest at an early stage, from idea conception through the search for product-market fit.

How we invest
“Most organisations don’t need more ideas. They need fewer, better ones, and the confidence to back the right move at the right time without setting fire to the rest of the business.”
How we work
We run lean
We start small and focus on eliminating uncertainties. There are no big-bang spends and no prolonged leaps of faith.
We absorb risk
Short notice periods, no big lock-ins. We lean into checkpoints and act as a risk buffer to help our partners take on big challenges.
We’re grown ups
We work well in sensitive contexts and we don’t break things that shouldn’t be broken. We’ll find the boundaries, but stay within them.
We’re autonomous
We don’t need babysitting. We take things and run with them, promising progress without becoming a time sink or distraction.
We collaborate
We establish key internal points of contact to stay aligned without slowing down. All of the required inputs without unnecessary committees.
We chase deeds over docs
We relentlessly experiment towards either validation or traction. People aren’t paying us for the documentation.

Privacy

Last updated: 5 August 2026

The49 Ltd ("we", "us", or "our") is committed to protecting and respecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect your personal data when you visit our website the49.com ("Website").

1. What information we collect

When you contact us, we collect only your name and email address.

2. How we use your information

We use personal data to:

Respond to enquiries and communicate about requested information
Protect the Website, establish legal claims and comply with legal obligations
3. Legal basis for processing

We rely on legitimate interests to respond to enquiries and operate and protect our business. We may also process data where necessary to comply with a legal obligation or establish, exercise or defend legal claims.

4. Who receives your information

The49 Ltd is the controller for the processing described in this policy. We use trusted hosting, communications and professional-service providers where necessary to operate the business.

We do not sell your personal data. We may disclose information where legally required, to protect legal rights, or as part of a business reorganisation.

5. Retention and security

Enquiry information is kept only while needed to respond, manage any resulting business relationship and meet legal requirements.

We use proportionate technical and organisational measures, including access controls and trusted service providers, to protect personal data. No internet service can be guaranteed completely secure.

6. Your rights

Depending on the circumstances, you may:

Access the personal data we hold about you
Ask us to correct or delete your data
Restrict or object to certain processing
Receive portable data where the right applies
Withdraw consent at any time, without affecting earlier lawful processing
Lodge a complaint with the Information Commissioner’s Office (ICO)

Contact us at intrigued@the49.com to exercise a right. We may need to verify your identity. You can contact the ICO at ico.org.uk.

7. Changes to this privacy policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We encourage you to review this page periodically for any changes.

8. Contact us

If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please contact us at:

intrigued@the49.com

9. Company info

The49 Ltd, 106 London Road, East Grinstead, RH19 1EP, GB

Company number: 14034040

Registered in England and Wales
